name: Rhombohedral graphene Hall bar · Long Ju structure
description: Long Ju (MIT) structure: a rhombohedral multilayer graphene domain (found by near-field IR / Raman and cut out by AFM or femtosecond laser) is picked up with the top hBN, graphite TG and hBN cap on PPC and landed on a prepared bottom stack (hBN + graphite BG); EBL + RIE into a Hall bar, Cr/Au contacts.

layers.name: Substrate
layers.notes: Choose 285 nm SiO2 on doped Si (usable as a global back gate) or on resistive Si.

layers.name: Bottom hBN
layers.notes: Straight edges misaligned to the graphene unless a moiré is wanted (Han 2024).
layers.literature: T. Han et al., arXiv:2305.03151 (pentalayer rhombohedral graphene), Methods

layers.name: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene
layers.literature: Rhombohedral domains identified by IR camera / near-field IR / Raman; isolated by AFM or fs-laser cutting (Han 2024, 2025).

layers.name: Top hBN (top-gate dielectric)

twist_deg.suggested_source: Z. Lu et al., Nature 626, 759 (2024), arXiv:2309.17436: moiré with the top hBN, ~0.77°

layers.notes: Aligned to the graphene only for a moiré device (Lu 2024: ~0.77°, period ~11.5 nm); otherwise misaligned.

layers.name: Graphite top gate
layers.literature: Han 2025: top hBN / graphite / middle hBN / ... ; Han 2024 used a NiCr top layer.

layers.name: Cr/Au contacts
layers.literature: 'Cr–Au for electrical connections' (Han 2025); thickness not stated.

references.cite: T. Han et al., arXiv:2305.03151 (pentalayer rhombohedral graphene), Methods
T. Han et al., arXiv:2408.15233 (chiral superconductivity, rhombohedral graphene), Methods

process: Exfoliate multilayer graphene; identify rhombohedral domains (IR camera, near-field IR, Raman).
Isolate the rhombohedral domain by AFM or femtosecond-laser cutting.
PPC film picks up the hBN cap, graphite TG, top hBN and the graphene; land on the prepared bottom stack (hBN + graphite BG).
EBL + RIE into a Hall bar.   [UStack Stage 2: Hall-bar etch]
Cr/Au contacts to source, drain, probes and gates.   [UStack Stage 2: contacts]
